changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'IntersectType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[IntersectType] ( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, SubjectClass int null, SubjectAssetTypeID int null, SubjectCardinality int CONSTRAINT [DF_IntersectType_SubjectCardinality] DEFAULT (2) NOT NULL, ObjectClass int null, ObjectAssetTypeID int null, ObjectCardinality int CONSTRAINT [DF_IntersectType_ObjectCardinality] DEFAULT (2) NOT NULL, PredicateID int NULL, IsSystem bit NULL, [State] int CONSTRAINT [DF_IntersectType_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CreatedBy int NULL, CreatedOn datetime NULL, UpdatedBy int NULL, UpdatedOn datetime NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntersectType_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, SourceID nvarchar(500) null, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntersectType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'IntersectType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectClass') begin alter table IntersectType add SubjectClass int null end
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'IntersectType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectAssetTypeID') begin alter table IntersectType add SubjectAssetTypeID int null end
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'IntersectType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectClass') begin alter table IntersectType add ObjectClass int null end
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'IntersectType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectAssetTypeID') begin alter table IntersectType add ObjectAssetTypeID int null end
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'IntersectType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SourceID') begin alter table IntersectType add SourceID nvarchar(500) null end
